stories.title: Proximity Metric Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the data contract for proximity including distance (miles/km), travel_time (minutes), origin (user location), destination (trial site), and calculation metadata. Ensure compatibility with existing clinical trials models.

stories.title: Travel Distance and Time Calculation Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to compute distance and travel time between user location and each clinical trial site using Google Routes integration. Handle multiple sites per trial and normalize outputs.

stories.title: Proximity API Exposure via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose proximity metrics through the evaluate care facade so that trial results include distance and travel time for each site. Ensure proper formatting for conversational output.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculations
stories.description: Develop tests validating correct distance and travel time calculations, handling of missing/invalid locations, and multiple trial site scenarios.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Service Integration with Google Routes
stories.description: Integrate and validate Google Routes API usage within the clinical trials service, including request construction, response parsing, error handling, and fallback behavior.
